title: The Legend of the Mystical Ninja - Ryukyu Palace (Rooftops)
description:
A very simple sky background from The Legend of the Mystical Ninja. It is perfect for parallaxing scrolling, which is how the original game uses it.

Obviously, it is a good fit for sky levels.
